key_features: User-Friendly Controls: Convenient Pair and Reset buttons make router management easy and accessible.
Broad Wireless Bandwidth Options: Supports 20/40/80/160MHz bandwidths, catering to diverse user needs.
Impressive Signal Rates: Achieves signal rates of 2402Mbps (5GHz) and 574Mbps (2.4GHz) for fast and reliable wireless connections.
Advanced Wireless Features: Incorporates OFDMA, MU-MIMO, and Beamforming for enhanced performance and reliability.
